E0611

`use alias.item` but item is not defined (D-MOD3)

What

`use alias.item` but item is not defined (D-MOD3)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0611

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0611: tests/ui/module_alias_item_missing.stderr.

Error [E0611]: `multiply` is not defined in module `math`
  --> tests/ui/module_alias_item_missing.jet:1:5
    |
  1 | use math.multiply
    |     ^^^^
 Why: check the module body for the item you're importing
 Fix: make sure the name is spelled correctly
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0611

Error [E0102]: nothing named `multiply` exists here
  --> tests/ui/module_alias_item_missing.jet:7:18
    |
  7 | fn run() { print(multiply(2, 3)) }
    |                  ^^^^^^^^
 Why: only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called
 Fix: define it first (fn multiply() { ... }), or call one that exists
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0102
